titleEn: Zema Global and SatYield Bring Satellite-Based Crop Intelligence to Agricultural Commodity Markets
titleZh: Zema Global与SatYield将卫星作物智能引入农产品商品市场
summaryZh: Zema Global与SatYield宣布合作，将SatYield基于卫星的作物产量与生产分析整合到Zema Global决策基础设施中。市场参与者可获取美国与巴西的产量预测、面积估算、作物状况指标、生长阶段、收获进度及天气影响指标等数据，辅助交易策略与风险管理。该合作对大豆、玉米及生物燃料相关能源市场参与者尤具价值。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了卫星遥感与AI作物模型在农产品供应链上游的深度应用，虽不直接涉及养殖环节，但其对饲料原料（大豆、玉米）产量与价格的预测能力，对智慧畜牧从业者判断饲料成本趋势和供应链风险具有间接参考价值。
contentFull:
By SatYield 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Zema Global, a leading provider of data and analytics solutions for companies engaged in the energy, commodities, and financial sectors, and SatYield, a provider of satellite-driven crop intelligence and forecasting, today announced a new partnership that will give agricultural commodity market participants access to SatYield’s in-season crop yield and production analytics through the Zema Global Decisioning Infrastructure.

 Through the partnership, Zema Global customers will be able to access SatYield data and analytical products covering the U.S. and Brazil, including yield forecasts, production forecasts, planted and harvested area estimates, condition indicators, growth stage and phenology, harvest progress, weather impact indicators, historical time series and backtesting data, as well as supporting metadata and documentation.

 Agricultural commodity markets can move significantly between traditional reporting points as weather, crop conditions, and production expectations evolve. By adding SatYield’s in-season crop intelligence to the Zema Global Decisioning Infrastructure, market participants can assess those developments alongside established market, weather, and supply-and-demand data. For existing Zema customers, SatYield adds an independent view of how crops are actually developing, synchronized within the organized, decision-ready data environment they already know and use.

 SatYield’s analytics combines satellite observations with biophysical crop modelling to provide in-season intelligence on crop development and production. By providing additional visibility into changes in crop conditions and potential yields during the growing season, the data can help market participants assess emerging supply dynamics as conditions develop.

 “Commodity markets do not need more data. They need earlier, independent signals that help them understand how physical supply is changing before it becomes market consensus,” said Gabby Nizri, Co-Founder and CEO of SatYield. “SatYield brings the physical crop signal, while Zema makes it decision-ready by synchronizing it with the market, weather, and fundamental data customers already use.”

 By bringing SatYield’s data into Zema Global’s Decisioning Infrastructure, customers can connect SatYield’s independent physical crop intelligence with the market and fundamental datasets already used in their decision-making models, including USDA and WASDE reports, weather, exchange data, and broader supply-and-demand intelligence.

 The partnership is particularly relevant for hedge funds and agricultural commodity traders active in markets including soy and corn, as well as energy market participants seeking greater visibility into yields and production dynamics relevant to biofuels.

 SatYield’s data can support use cases including forecasting production, assessing regional conditions, informing market analysis, trading strategies, and risk management by analyzing the impact of weather on productivity and incorporating in-season intelligence into broader supply-and-demand analysis.

 “SatYield brings an innovative source of crop intelligence to the market,” said Eric Steimel, Chief Data Officer at Zema Global. “Through the Zema Global Decisioning Infrastructure, customers can bring that signal into a decision-ready data foundation and make faster, more informed decisions as markets become more complex.”

 SatYield has demonstrated the ability to identify meaningful changes in acreage, yield and production during the growing season, providing an independent forward-looking signal as crop conditions evolve and ahead of final official estimates.

translationZh:
Zema Global是一家为能源、大宗商品和金融领域企业提供数据与分析解决方案的领先供应商，SatYield则是一家提供卫星驱动作物智能与预测的服务商。今日，双方宣布建立新的合作伙伴关系，将使农产品商品市场参与者能够通过Zema Global决策基础设施获取SatYield的季内作物产量与生产分析。

通过该合作，Zema Global的客户将能够访问SatYield覆盖美国和巴西的数据与分析产品，包括产量预测、生产预测、种植与收获面积估算、状况指标、生长阶段与物候、收获进度、天气影响指标、历史时间序列与回测数据，以及配套的元数据和文档。

农产品商品市场在传统报告节点之间可能因天气、作物状况和产量预期变化而出现大幅波动。通过将SatYield的季内作物智能添加到Zema Global决策基础设施中，市场参与者可以在已有的市场、天气和供需数据旁评估这些动态。对于现有Zema客户而言，SatYield增加了关于作物实际生长情况的独立视角，并同步到他们已熟悉和使用的有序、决策就绪的数据环境中。

SatYield的分析将卫星观测与生物物理作物模型相结合，提供关于作物生长和生产的季内智能。通过在生长季期间提供对作物状况和潜在产量变化的额外可见性，这些数据可以帮助市场参与者随着情况发展评估新兴的供应动态。

SatYield联合创始人兼首席执行官Gabby Nizri表示：“商品市场不需要更多数据。他们需要更早的、独立的信号，帮助他们在物理供应变化成为市场共识之前理解这些变化。SatYield带来物理作物信号，而Zema通过将其与客户已使用的市场、天气和基本面数据同步，使其成为决策就绪的数据。”

通过将SatYield的数据引入Zema Global的决策基础设施，客户可以将SatYield独立的物理作物智能与其决策模型中已使用的市场和基本面数据集连接起来，包括USDA和WASDE报告、天气、交易所数据以及更广泛的供需情报。

该合作对活跃于大豆和玉米等市场的对冲基金和农产品商品交易商，以及寻求更深入了解与生物燃料相关的产量和生产动态的能源市场参与者尤其相关。

SatYield的数据可支持多种用例，包括预测产量、评估区域状况、为市场分析提供信息、交易策略和风险管理，具体方式包括分析天气对生产力的影响，并将季内智能纳入更广泛的供需分析。

Zema Global首席数据官Eric Steimel表示：“SatYield为市场带来了创新的作物智能来源。通过Zema Global决策基础设施，客户可以将该信号引入决策就绪的数据基础，并在市场变得更加复杂时做出更快、更明智的决策。”

SatYield已证明能够在生长季期间识别种植面积、产量和生产的显著变化，随着作物状况演变并在最终官方估计之前提供独立的前瞻性信号。

SatYield是一家卫星驱动的作物智能公司，提供关于农业生产的独立季内智能。其技术结合地球观测、人工智能和生物物理作物建模，在整个生长季估算种植面积、产量、生产、作物状况和收获进度。
